Tapping them silently does nothing.

AccountScreen.kt:652,659,666,673 — the AppSettingsCard's four SettingsRow items (Language, Currency, Units, Theme) each display a static hardcoded value ('English'/'EUR'/'Metric'/'System') and are wired to `onClick = { /* picker */ }` — no picker opens, and the displayed value never reflects real state, so all four app-settings controls are cosmetic no-ops.

AccountScreen is the live Account tab, reachable in production (Navigation.kt:255 `AccountScreen(...)`). Net: 7 user-facing tappable rows on the primary account surface are dead controls; users tapping Compare/Privacy/About/Language/Currency/Units/Theme get no response and no feedback.

mobile-native/androidApp/src/main/java/three/two/bit/ppt/reality/navigation/Navigation.kt:113,349-354 — Screen.TwoFactor ('auth/two-factor') is declared and registered as a composable, but `grep -n 'navigate(Screen.TwoFactor'` over Navigation.kt returns ZERO hits: nothing in the login/SSO flow ever navigates to the 2FA challenge. The route is an orphan.

Navigation.kt:350-353 — the TwoFactorScreen is wired with only `onBackClick`/`onDone`, and `onDone = { navController.popBackStack() }` just pops the back stack; no ssoService/verify callback is passed, so even if reached the screen cannot actually verify a code against the backend.

mobile-native/androidApp/src/main/java/three/two/bit/ppt/reality/ui/auth/TwoFactorScreen.kt:164 — the 'Use backup code' TextButton is a dead handler `onClick = { /* backup code */ }`, and the 'resend' affordance (line 158) is a plain non-clickable Text. The 2FA UI is fully built but disconnected from auth: no entry path, no verification wiring, and its recovery controls are no-ops.

mobile-native/androidApp/src/main/java/three/two/bit/ppt/reality/ui/profile/ProfileEditScreen.kt:68-69,261-292 — the screen exposes editable OutlinedTextFields for `phone` and `aboutMe` (with a 280-char counter), so a user can type into and edit both.

ProfileEditScreen.kt:59,117 — the `onSubmit` callback signature is `suspend (displayName: String) -> Result<Unit>` and the save button calls `onSubmit(displayName.trim())` only; phone and About-me values are never passed. Confirmed by the wiring in Navigation.kt:358 `onSubmit = { displayName -> ssoService.updateProfile(displayName).map {} }`.

The doc comment at ProfileEditScreen.kt:47-49 acknowledges 'phone, language, and About me don't have backing endpoints yet'. Net: two editable form fields silently discard user input on save with no disabled state or warning — the form gives a false illusion of persistence (silent data loss on a user-facing profile edit).
